load_text_encoder: load a text embedding pipeline with a sonar encoder for English text
load_text_translator: load a text-to-text translation pipeline using the sonar basic encoder and decoder
create_encoder_config: create a SonarEncoderConfig with tokenizer, encoder, and language settings for sonar
get_cached_encoder: get a cached text encoder pipeline using lru_cache for repeated sonar encoding calls
get_cached_translator: get a cached text translator pipeline using lru_cache for repeated sonar translation calls
